UnitAttribute.description: Placeholder - no implementation found in code.
Unit is immune to morale effects and will never route from battle. Checked in TORBattleMoraleModel.CanPanicDueToMorale.
Unit cannot be knocked down or staggered by any attack. Checked in TORAgentApplyDamageModel.DecideAgentShrugOffBlow.
Placeholder - no specific implementation found in code.
Attacks ignore 40% of target armor. Applied in TORStrikeMagnitudeModel.CalculateAdjustedArmorForBlow as a -0.4f armor factor.
Marks unit as a knight-class mounted warrior. Used to identify knight units for career perks (KnightOldWorld, Runelord). Affects troop classification via CharacterObjectExtensions.IsKnightUnit.
Monster-class melee attacks that can only be blocked with shields. Weapon parries are automatically crushed through. Implemented in TORAgentApplyDamageModel.DecideCrushedThrough.
Undead unit immune to morale effects (cannot panic or route). Used throughout the codebase for faction logic, raise dead mechanics, and morale checks.
Can operate artillery pieces. With party leader's SteelTerror perk, artillery crew becomes immune to panic (TORBattleMoraleModel).
Hero can deploy artillery pieces on the battlefield. Checked in AbilityManagerMissionLogic to calculate team artillery slots.
Basic artillery crew certification. No reload speed bonus (baseline). Used in TORSiegeEngineCalculationModel.
Mid-tier Cannoneer certification. Reduces artillery reload time by 15% as operator, 20% as reloader. Applied in TORSiegeEngineCalculationModel.CalculateCannonReloadSpeed.
Elite Cannoneer certification. Reduces artillery reload time by 30% as operator, 35% as reloader. Applied in TORSiegeEngineCalculationModel.CalculateCannonReloadSpeed.
Unit cannot use siege ladders. Checked in CharacterObjectExtensions.CanClimbLadders - returns false if unit has this attribute.
Combined with 'medium_humanoid_monster' race to identify Minotaur units. Minotaurs are considered large targets (CharacterObjectExtensions.IsLargeTarget).
Tree spirit unit. Immune to morale effects (TORBattleMoraleModel), and always ignores 80% of enemy armor when attacking (TORStrikeMagnitudeModel).
Applies permanent 'troll_regeneration' status effect in battle, causing health regeneration over time. Applied in StatusEffectMissionLogic.CheckUnitForAddingPermanentEffects.
Greenskin big boss designation. Used for Waaagh mechanics and leadership bonuses.
Chosen of the Dark Gods designation. Used for faction-specific mechanics.
Legendary lord character. Excluded from loot drops (LootCampaignBehavior).
Dwarven Slayer Lord. Enables special recruitment of Slayer units in Dwarf towns (TORAIRecruitmentCampaignBehavior).

Marks unit as part of Dwarven Ironbreaker troop line. Affects Ironbreaker career perks: upgrade costs (-25%), physical resistance (+20%), damage bonuses, and ammunition bonuses per Ironbeard companion.
Bretonnian knight. Combined with Bretonnia culture check to identify Bretonnian knights (HeroExtensions.IsBretonnianKnight). Enables Lady of the Lake blessings and knight-specific mechanics.
Knight of peasant origin. Special recruitment behavior in TORAIRecruitmentCampaignBehavior for Bretonnia faction.
Empire NPC with Special occupation. Provides prestige exchange services to Empire-culture players at Clan Level 2+ (PrestigeNobleTownBehavior).
Member of a Dwarven guild. Used for guild membership checks.
Equipped with Dwarven firearm. Units with this attribute have increased Oathgold upkeep costs (TORPartyWageModel, TORPartyTroopUpgradeModel).
Dwarven miner unit. Identifies miners for Gemcutters Guild benefits - enables ore and gem production bonuses in owned fiefs (OathGoldBehavior).
Dwarven Runesmith hero. Enables runic enchanting at Runesmith Guild. Required companion attribute for Runelord career (EnchanterTownBehavior, OathGoldBehavior).
Can cast spells in battle. Checked via AgentExtensions.IsSpellCaster for spell-related UI and AI casting behavior.
Has special combat abilities. Triggers AbilityComponent addition in AbilityManagerMissionLogic.OnAgentCreated. AI-controlled ability users also get WizardAIComponent.
Necromancer career identifier. Used for raise dead mechanics, cursed site interactions, and undead-related campaign behaviors.
Powerful summoned necromancer champion. With BookofWsoranKeystone career choice, these champions shrug off all damage (AgentExtensions.IsDamageShruggedOff) and gain career bonuses.
Necrarch vampire bloodline. Used for race identification (FaceGen 'necrarch'), vampire checks, and Necrarch career mechanics.
Blood Dragon vampire bloodline. Has special conversation tags (BloodDragonTag) and bloodline-specific mechanics (CharacterObjectExtensions.IsBloodDragon).
AI-controlled companion with Special occupation. Used to track spawned AI companions (TORConsoleCommands.whereAreAICompanions). Attribute removed on death.
Empire faction envoy. Provides diplomatic and resource exchange services for Empire players.
Dark Elf (Druchii) envoy. Provides services for Dark Elf faction interactions.
High Elf (Asur) envoy. Provides services for High Elf faction interactions.
Wood Elf Spellsinger envoy. Provides magical services for Wood Elf faction (Eonir favor mechanics).
Wood Elf Glade Captain. Military leader role for Wood Elf faction.
Engineer companion hero. Can place artillery in battle (counted toward team artillery limit in AbilityManagerMissionLogic). Works with CanPlaceArtillery for artillery deployment.
Empire Master Engineer NPC. Trains Engineering skill (SkillTrainerBehavior). Located in Nuln.
Generic NPC that can train skills. Base attribute for training NPCs.
Priest NPC who can train others. Generic priest trainer designation.
Priest of Sigmar. Determines religion affiliation and unlocks Sigmar-specific prayers/abilities. Used in HeroExtensions.IsPriest and GetReligionFromAttribute.
Priest of Shallya. Goddess of healing and mercy. Determines religion affiliation and unlocks Shallya-specific prayers/abilities.
Priest of Ulric. God of winter, wolves, and battle. Determines religion affiliation and unlocks Ulric-specific prayers. Required for WarriorPriestUlric career.
Priestess of the Lady of the Lake. Bretonnian goddess. Grants spell power bonus with EnvoyOfTheLadyPassive3 career choice (TORAbilityModel).
NPC provides Sigmar faith training. Trains Faith skill for Cult of Sigmar (SkillTrainerBehavior).
NPC provides Ulric faith training. Trains Faith skill for Cult of Ulric (SkillTrainerBehavior).
Shallya training variant - provides Medicine skill training (SkillTrainerBehavior).
Shallya religious training variant - provides Medicine skill training (SkillTrainerBehavior).
Unit has special animation-triggered effects via AnimationTriggerMissionLogic. Units with this attribute are excluded from joust and archery contest tournaments.
Cursed hero. Each IllFated hero in party adds +10% chance of negative random events during TORCareerPerkCampaignBehavior checks.
Dark Elf shadowblood designation. Placeholder - no specific implementation found in searched code.
